global_observations: negative-preview-8bit images are visually positive post-negation previews, not raw negative density measurements
date imprints, black or dark frame edges, crop/aspect differences, exposure and scan/render variation are visible shortcut cues
roll identity is strongly entangled with place, event, lighting and content; ordinary frame-random classification is forbidden

stock_observations.fujifilm_nph_400: four rolls but strong roll-to-event/location/lighting coupling; date imprints, dark borders and extreme night/exposure variation are visible
stock_observations.kodak_ga_100_5095: severely imbalanced: 13 frames from the main zoo roll, one frame from a second roll and two from a third; content/location separation is structurally weak
stock_observations.kodak_gold_100_gen5: seven preview rolls and a separate proxy lane, but location/content/date/crop cues remain strongly roll-linked; bright clipping and scan marks require nuisance controls
stock_observations.konica_super_xg_100: mostly daytime outdoor travel frames with roll/location/date coupling, visible date imprints and border/crop/cast variation

rf1_4_gate: preregister shortcut/null tests, whole-roll folds and crop/date/border sensitivity before any stock-signal interpretation
claim_ceiling: autonomous visual evidence at contact-sheet scale only; no stock signal, authenticity, calibration, full-resolution artifact or population preference claim
